items.text: the Pack is a tab of the Sound panel, at the panel's size and place with its tabs and ⌄, instead of a box in the middle of the screen
the little carets over and under the bar sit just above and just below their buttons again, an even gap each side
every label in a shelf shows whole (PATTERN, not PATTE…), with more room between a color chip and its name
a shelf above the bar grows until its point reaches its own button
the dice's ring when it is playing is a soft dark teal on white, with smooth edges
one word for your sounds: pack. The sound shelf's button says pack, the sheet is the Pack, and Save as a pack saves one to share
the four ways a sound plays (Touch, On the beat, Bed, Pattern) have icons in the Pack sheet
the sound pack guide opens Current from a card with its icon, gives the two packs their own icons, and starts with what makes Current a pleasure to play
six more Paths: Water, Material, Share, Robot, Collections and Play together. Every step's take me there opens the shelf or panel its control is on
Path 05's steps point at the sounds where they are now: the beats and bytebeats in the shelf under the bar, Save in the sound panel's Bytes
the Guide in the index explains the bar's four gestures (tap, drag up for the panel, drag down for the shelf, hold for both), the shelf, the panels, the robot and its collections, Water and sharing

the colophon says exactly what leaves your device, and credits the water's foundations (Hugo Elias, Evan Wallace, Phong, Minnaert), OKLab, the Audio EQ Cookbook, Ableton Link, Supabase and GoatCounter
a beat you named yourself is never counted by name

Room, for playing together: each performer on their own phone or laptop with their own sound, in time over the internet, no MIDI. Make a room and read its code out, or join with a code (index › Room, the bar's room tool, or the o key)

one leads: everyone follows its tempo and beat one, and its scene changes land on the same beat everywhere, with its morph. The leader's switch: Free, Tempo or Scenes; each follower picks Tempo and/or Scene, and can step out

who is in, who leads, and how close each clock is (±ms), in the Room section; a pill at the top of the stage shows the room, how many, and the sync. Hand the lead to anyone; if the leader leaves, the next in line takes over
Nudge moves your beat a little earlier or later, for a speaker that lags (Bluetooth most of all)
Session became Room: one system. Ableton Link stays (the Link helper on the laptop gives the leader its tempo); codes are now six characters
the beats line up where they are heard (the audio clock's output time), so tapped and shared tempos sit on the beat on every device

moving stickers. In Capture's sticker shelf, Still or Moving: Moving records three seconds of the field inside the duck-rabbit, with its frame and extras, clear outside, looping without a seam, 600 px at 15 fps. A GIF by default; the share sheet writes the same sticker again as APNG (a soft edge, for iMessage and Telegram) or WebP (512 square under 500 KB, for WhatsApp) without recording again, and shows its size
the share sheet's "make it as" row has Moving, so a GIF, a still or a sticker becomes a moving sticker (the sheet steps aside while it records), and a moving sticker becomes a still one on the spot
the live sticker preview says "moving" when Moving is on

Settings has a Performing switch. On, nothing reloads by itself mid-show, the update notice waits until you turn it off, and the screen stays awake. It is also on by itself while you are in a room, or while auto play runs in fullscreen
auto play keeps the screen awake while it runs
a shared scene, a pack or a room can only bring colors, settings and words, never anything that runs on the page
bytebeat formulas from packs, links and files are read by Current's own formula reader and never run as code; a formula it cannot read is refused with a note
opening Current no longer keeps a copy of the scene online; a scene link is made only when you open the cards or ask for a link
on a slow or stuck connection Current opens from what it kept within a few seconds, instead of waiting
the visitor count no longer sees a shared scene's link or a room's code

now and then, when there is no update, a word from the studio in the update's place: a question to answer, news, or a call for artists and volunteers. At most once every few days, never in the first minute, never while the robot, a recording or the bare stage is running
Settings has a News switch (Off / On) for the studio's questions and news

your own recordings in the kit. Import wav, mp3, ogg, m4a or flac files (several at once, a folder on a laptop, or drop them on the open kit): each becomes a sound, under 3 s a one-shot, longer a loop that holds, and plays by touch, on the beat, as a bed or from the pattern

sound packs with recordings. A pack zip (pack.json, instrument.json, samples/) opens from kit › Import… or dropped anywhere on Current, with each sound's role already set; Save as a set saves one, recordings included, to share
recordings stay on this device, so your kit is there next time
the Sound section links the sound pack guide, with a starter pack of water sounds and a template (made for the Frost Electronic Music Ensemble)
kit sounds playing on their own (a bed, a beat or a pattern with the beat off) now move the field and light the speaker
